True def transform(grid):
    # In these binary-noise grids, recolor every 5 to the other palette color,
    # and turn that other color into 0.
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row}
    other = next((v for v in colors if v != 5), None)
    if other is None:
        return [[5 for v in row] for row in grid]
    return [[other if v == 5 else 0 for v in row] for row in grid]
